traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Action meets disruption. Impulsive, risk-taking, rebellious energy, with impatience and a pull toward technology. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of drive and disruption is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Innovative and fast; the cost is recklessness and volatility.
shadow: Anger and recklessness fused with instability for its own sake, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
